comparisonMethod: Every actual PDF page rendered at300dpi using PyMuPDF page.get_pixmap(dpi=300,alpha=False); compare against original native tile image at2550x3300. Binary ink means grayscale<128. Every name/pay/expense ink pixel must have an opposite-view ink counterpart within1pixel using a3x3maxfilter. Exact binary differences are also counted, without pretending antialiasing images are identical.
rowBoundaryMethod: Independently project actual source ink in fixed name-column ROI x190:1600,y685:3070; merge vertical ink gaps at most8pixels. Final page uses y685:2600, excluding the separately identified ruled Total row. Compare band count and each band center to both independent OCR geometries, tolerance10pixels (row spacing about48pixels). No assumption that earlier pages have49rows.

actualPdfHeaderTranscript.scope: Alphabetical list of employees who received remuneration exceeding$75,000 for the year endedMarch31,2025; expenses paid in the period may be reimbursed directly and/or paid to a third-party supplier.

sourceFidelityAlertDisposition: The initial extraCarol/clipped-name alert was corrected by its reviewer as a first-pass image-reading error. Actual page100 Harder,Catherine matches the native crop. interpretation: Every named field region has the same ink shape within one raster pixel in both directions, with no letter-sized added/omitted regions. Exact antialiasing/resampling pixels differ, as quantified. Native-crop image readings may be reused with this source-view qualification; original source text and raw evidence remain unchanged.
limits: The1pixel geometric tolerance is explicitly not exact PNG identity and does not independently identify every letter. It supplements independent OCR agreement and individual original-image conflict review.
